segments.text: namaste, main police station se bol raha hoon
aapke naam par ek case darj hua hai
ye bahut serious hai, aapko arrest ho sakta hai
kisi ko nahi batana, warna case aur badhega
aapko abhi ek payment karni hogi bail ke liye
mujhe aapka OTP chahiye verify karne ke liye
turant karo, koi der mat karo
